title: We Create Tomorrow: karaoke software for the anthem of Trường Kinh tế, Đại học Cần Thơ
description:
We Create Tomorrow is a browser-based karaoke application developed to disseminate the anthem of Trường Kinh tế, Đại học Cần Thơ (School of Economics, Can Tho University) in two language versions — Vietnamese (“Chúng ta cùng đi”) and English (“We Create Tomorrow”). The application renders time-synchronized lyrics during playback, supports instant switching between the two language versions, and provides a supplementary sheet-music view for practice. All processing occurs client-side; the application has no server component and collects no personal data.

Implemented in TypeScript, React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Source code, licensing terms, and author contribution details accompany this deposit and the related copyright-registration dossier at github.com/thuyhuongctu/School-of-Economics.
